cases.sentence: Мария Магдалина пошла к гробнице и увидела, что ___, закрывавший вход в гробницу, убран.
cases.translation: Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone blocking the entrance to the tomb had been removed.
cases.explain: Камень is the subject of убран ('removed'), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: «Они забрали Господа из ___, и мы не знаем, куда они его положили».
cases.translation: 'They have taken the Lord out of the tomb, and we don't know where they laid him.'
cases.explain: The preposition из ('out of') governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Мария Магдалина пошла к ___ и сказала, «Я видела Господа».
cases.translation: Mary Magdalene went to the disciples and said, 'I have seen the Lord.'
cases.explain: The preposition к ('to, toward') governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Кому вы простите ___, тем они будут прощены, а на ком оставите грехи, на тех они останутся.
cases.translation: If you forgive anyone's sins, they are forgiven them; if you retain the sins of any, they are retained.
cases.explain: Простите ('forgive') takes its object in the accusative case; for this inanimate plural noun the accusative equals the nominative.

cases.sentence: Пока я не увижу следов от гвоздей на его руках, не коснусь их ___ и не потрогаю рану в его боку, я не поверю.
cases.translation: Unless I see the mark of the nails in his hands, touch them with my finger, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.
cases.explain: The instrumental case here expresses the instrument used ('touch with a finger') without a preposition.

cases.sentence: Иисус совершил в присутствии своих учеников и много других знамений, о которых в этой ___ не написано.
cases.translation: Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book.
cases.explain: The preposition в ('in') governs the prepositional case here, indicating location within the book.

reading.ru: Мария Магдалина пошла к гробнице и увидела, что камень, закрывавший вход в гробницу, убран.
reading.question: What did Mary Magdalene discover at the tomb early in the morning?
options: The stone had been removed from the entrance
The tomb was guarded by soldiers
The body was wrapped and untouched
reading.correct: The stone had been removed from the entrance
reading.explain: Mary Magdalene found that the stone blocking the entrance to the tomb had been removed.

reading.question: What did the other disciple do when he entered the tomb and saw the linen cloths?
reading.explain: The other disciple entered the tomb, saw the linen cloths, and believed.

reading.ru: Плача, она заглянула в гробницу и увидела двух ангелов в белом.
reading.question: What did Mary see when she looked into the tomb while weeping?
reading.explain: While weeping, Mary looked into the tomb and saw two angels dressed in white.

reading.question: How did Mary finally recognize that the man speaking to her was Jesus?
options: A disciple identified him for her
reading.explain: Mary recognized Jesus when he spoke her name.

reading.ru: Мария Магдалина пошла к ученикам и сказала, «Я видела Господа»,
reading.question: What did Mary Magdalene tell the disciples after seeing Jesus?
reading.explain: Mary Magdalene went to the disciples and told them, 'I have seen the Lord.'

reading.ru: Он стал посреди них и сказал, «Мир вам!»
reading.question: What did Jesus say when he appeared to the disciples behind locked doors?
options: "Do not be afraid of the Jews"
reading.explain: Jesus stood among them and said, 'Peace be with you!'

reading.ru: «Пока я не увижу следов от гвоздей на его руках, не коснусь их пальцем и не потрогаю рану в его боку, я не поверю».
reading.question: What did Thomas say he needed in order to believe Jesus had risen?
options: To see and touch the wounds in Jesus's hands and side
To see the empty tomb himself
To speak with the other disciples again
reading.correct: To see and touch the wounds in Jesus's hands and side
reading.explain: Thomas said he would not believe unless he saw and touched the nail marks and the wound in Jesus's side.

reading.ru: «Господь мой и Бог мой!» — сказал ему в ответ Фома.
reading.question: What did Thomas say when Jesus showed him his wounds?
reading.explain: When Jesus showed him the wounds, Thomas responded, 'My Lord and my God!'

reading.ru: А то, что здесь написано, написано для того, чтобы вы поверили, что Иисус есть Христос, Сын Бога, и, веруя, имели бы жизнь во имя Его.
reading.question: Why does John say these things were written?
options: So that readers may believe Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and have life in his name
To honor Peter above the other disciples
reading.correct: So that readers may believe Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and have life in his name
reading.explain: John states that these things were written so readers would believe Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and have life in his name.
